posts.title: The Two Parent Household is a Modern Consequence
posts.description: We talk about the two-parent household as if it were the ancient default we're losing. It isn't. For most of history, two parents were the core of a much larger care system. In 1850 the average American family had 5.55 people; today we're at roughly half that.
